All four rungs of your morning ladder are built, proven, and live — plus the taps-icon fix along the way. Live build is **127**; here's the day so far:

**1. Consent once, all your devices** (`review/consent-once`, build 122). The acceptance is now the *only* key: launch and mid-session self-apply both check "has this user accepted this build?" instead of policy, and auto's per-device self-apply stands down (untick the node and it returns). The OK mirrors to localStorage, so a phone that slept through your acceptance applies silently on next wake. This resolves the handover's auto-vs-one-OK question in favour of one OK, always.

**2. The upgrade review** (`review/upgrade`, build 125). Deploy now stamps changes.json with the node paths each build touched and added (#p54's cheap half, finally built). In the awaiting section, brand-new features wear a **new** badge and arrive pre-ticked by your updates setting — *automatic* ticks them, the other two leave them for you. Their ticks are **drafts**: tapping flips locally, and only pressing **upgrade** commits your choices (durably, through the outbox) and accepts fleet-wide. One open question filed in notes.md: *fixes auto* and *ask me* now pre-tick identically, so the three-way picker may want to become two — your call.

**3. Seamless upgrades** (`review/seamless`, build 126). An accepted build won't reload while you're recording, listening, or transcribing — it fires on the first idle moment. And the whole loop state is stashed across the reload: in the test, the instance came back inside the taps tool with its count intact.

**4. The ask inbox** (`noob-button/ask`, build 127) — the nøøb ladder's first grade. The system panel grew an ask box: "count my taps" surfaces an **open taps** chip (lands you in the tool) plus matching feature rows you can read; anything muon can't do files itself into your user-scoped `asks` — which persists on the mini where I read it, and deploy now prints unaddressed asks next to its nodeless-release warning. The proposal/in-progress lifecycle states stay as named next rungs.

Also shipped: **steady toolbar** (build 124) — your taps-icon jump was the mount slide-in animation replaying on every whole-DOM re-render (up to three times per tap, thanks to sync echoes); it now plays only on actual tool changes.

Every node passed its toggle proof, and everything ran through the CDP rig against the real app. Your devices are dogfooding rung 1 right now: they're holding at their current build until you open the feature list and press upgrade once. Try the ask box while you're in there.
